claims.text: It was AARO's first official market research solicitation; the system is to track data, interactions and other records related to UAP investigations and to support a public UAP reporting mechanism AARO plans to launch.

claims.nodeLabel: AARO JWICS case management system (sources sought, May 2025)
claims.text: Hosting the consolidated UAP case record on JWICS places it at the Top Secret/SCI level by default regardless of the classification of individual cases, which is a structural obstacle to release that no declassification directive in 2026 addresses. Reasoning: JWICS is the TS/SCI network; a database resident on it inherits that handling.
